tool.name: Move Google Drive File
tool.description: Move a file or folder to a different location in Google Drive by changing its parent folders. NOTE: Requires the google_drive connector template's update-file endpoint to be updated with query parameter mapping for addParents and removeParents. Currently returns file metadata without moving it.

fileId.description: The ID of the file or folder to move

addParents.description: Comma-separated list of parent folder IDs to add (destination folders)

removeParents.description: Comma-separated list of parent folder IDs to remove (current location). If not specified, the file will keep its current parents.

nodes.name: Move File via Google Drive API
